paragraphs.text: CISA added four actively exploited vulnerabilities in widely deployed enterprise infrastructure — Apache Roller, Cisco Expressway, SAP NetWeaver, and VMware vCenter — to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, while threat actors simultaneously weaponized a Cisco Expressway flaw within days of proof-of-concept release and a China-linked group exploited a VMware vCenter zero-day for administrative access. These developments compress remediation windows for critical assets and demand immediate asset inventory, patch verification, and lateral movement assessment.

Cloud and identity supply chain risks materialized through a Rackspace Spot credential compromise exposing customer Kubernetes secrets, a Microsoft Entra Connect Health breach revealing administrator emails and tenant configuration, and a Linux KVM hypervisor flaw enabling cross-VM memory reading on AMD hosts. Control owners must validate third-party access scopes, rotate compromised secrets, audit identity synchronization permissions, and confirm hypervisor patch deployment on affected hardware configurations.
